exposure: preoperative use of internal iliac artery balloon occlusion (IIABO) catheters
cohort: 67 pregnancies complicated by abnormal invasive placenta
finding: Preoperative placement of IIABO catheters in patients undergoing cesarean delivery for invasive placentation did not significantly reduce intraoperative blood loss or the need for additional hemostatic measures.
mod_finding: Cesarean hysterectomy was performed less frequently in the IIABO group (21.1%) compared to the no-IIABO group (29.4%), but this difference was not statistically significant.
